acceptance: ClickBench bundles exist at SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0 on BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake (9 bundles); CoffeeShop at SF 0.1, 1.0 (6 bundles); H2ODB at SF 0.1, 1.0 (6 bundles); 21 bundles in total
The seven Databricks bundles (ClickBench x3, CoffeeShop x2, H2ODB x2) are rerun on current develop because the 2026-09-19/20 bundles lack the result-cache receipt the validator now requires

The cause of ClickBench's scale-invariant timings (geomean x1.00 to x1.45 across 100x scale on all six BigQuery, Snowflake and Databricks bundles) is determined (result cache, fixed overhead, or generator size) and recorded before any override is authored; each remaining scale-invariant or timing-plateau override carries a maintainer-written reason
The two stray ClickBench BigQuery files (a partial run, 20260919_184034_070d9adb, and a data-only run, 20260919_185659_317ef35f) are excluded from submission
100% query pass rate across all runs
All 21 result bundles pass scripts/validate_submission.py with 0 errors and carry result_source=internal
context:
Builds on first-live-cloud-benchmark-run-and-publish, which is done. Ensure GCS/S3/Snowflake staging bucket permissions and table creation scripts handle wide schemas cleanly.

Revalidated 2026-10-01. Query counts match the loaded classes (43 / 11 / 10). The registry lists ClickBench scale_options as [1.0] only, but only min_scale (0.01) is enforced, so SF 0.1 and 10.0 are valid. The earlier statement that ClickBench SF 10 is 100M rows (~15 GB raw) is wrong for BenchBox: core/clickbench/generator.py creates 1,000,000 x scale_factor rows. These suites are not rows of the 84-cell corpus campaign. Rerunning the seven Databricks cells needs an approval that states command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition, and a check of the 500-table Unity Catalog quota first (the low-scale-factor ClickBench, CoffeeShop and H2ODB schemas were dropped to free quota). Overrides are maintainer decisions.
description:
Publish live cloud benchmark results across BigQuery, Databricks, and Snowflake for the Industry benchmark suites:
- ClickBench: 43 queries on web analytics hits data (SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0)
- CoffeeShop: 11 analytical queries on retail/coffee transactional schema (SF 0.1, 1.0)
- H2ODB: 10 analytical queries for ML data preparation (SF 0.1, 1.0)

Runs from 2026-09-19/20 already exist locally for every cell but none is published. Under the current validator 26 of 41 local bundle files for the six Industry and Academic suites pass; the rest need reruns or overrides (see acceptance). BenchBox's ClickBench generator makes 1M rows per scale factor, so SF 10 is 10M synthetic rows.
Capture valid result bundles satisfying the cohort gate (results-data/validate_corpus.py and scripts/validate_submission.py).
